unit_template:
[Unit]
Description=Lyra Chat Router API
After=network.target

[Service]
User=root
WorkingDirectory=/opt/lyra-chat-router-runtime/current
EnvironmentFile=/opt/lyra-chat-router-api/.env
ExecStart=/opt/lyra-chat-router-api/.venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3201
Restart=always
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
migration_policy: no migration command; unchanged schema/startup DDL and worker compatibility required; otherwise blocked
